verdict.rationale: AiPrise documents domain-specific background automation: ongoing re-screening of businesses, UBOs and directors, live risk monitoring that auto-flags when a threshold is crossed, and score-driven auto-decisioning with tunable thresholds. These are fixed compliance automations configured through thresholds and dashboard flow edits, not a general facility for users to build their own autonomous automations. Missing for 10: a general user-defined automation or workflow builder, documented scheduling or trigger configuration, details on how the background runs are set up or controlled, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Ongoing re-screening of business, UBOs, and directors against sanctions, PEP, watchlists, and adverse media.
Monitoring feeds a live risk score that auto-flags for review when it crosses your threshold.
Scoring drives auto-decisioning, with thresholds tunable per segment, geography, or product line.
Screens against watchlists and adjudicates alerts, clearing the noise before it ever hits your queue.
